impact_assessment.why: AIKit has no target-project concept: a project under it pollutes AIKit's map, runs AIKit's tests, and shares AIKit's ledger
impact_assessment.benefits: open AIKit in any host, describe a project, work happens isolated in projects/<name> with its own memory
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new aikit.py CLI and --project flag; dependency: none (stdlib, git); concurrency: per-project ledgers reduce collisions; state: new per-project .aikit/ files (schema in data_models.md)
impact_assessment.mitigation: argparse with triad errors; pure functions unit-tested; integration test in a temp dir; AIKit gates ignore projects/
